about: RollSense's subjects (FR-141 S6, ADR-0056, ADR-0059): TinyCLIP-39M unchanged, label sets and naming rules measured on the owner's labels (counts only; the photos and their names stay outside the repository). Every round is an exact recomputation from stored per-photo probabilities or embeddings (a softmax over some prompts is the summed shares renormalised). RESULT §42.

rule: Written before measuring (2026-11-19): no labelled set loses more than 2 points against the version shipped; fewest Other on the library wins. Replaced for later rounds (2026-11-20, after three reviews: 2 points is under one standard error at n = 200) by: the photos a candidate names beyond the current one are at least 75 % right, on at least 30 such photos, with the Wilson lower bound reported.
